subject.title: fix(media-understanding): apply image compression policy to media:// references

question: Should this proof-positive but conflicted branch be repaired as the canonical fix, or should maintainers wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102002 to add equivalent real-behavior proof and become the landing candidate?
rationale: Both PRs target the same canonical issue, but this branch has stronger proof and three concrete repairable blockers while the competing branch is broader and currently lacks live proof; automation should not choose the canonical contributor branch.

options.title: Repair this branch
options.body: Rebase this PR and fix the shared-resolver, HEIC-ordering, and source-cap blockers while preserving its existing oversized-image proof.

options.title: Promote the competing PR
options.body: Pause this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102002 is clean, proof-positive, and confirmed to cover the same three contracts.

recommendation.title: Repair this branch
recommendation.body: Rebase this PR and fix the shared-resolver, HEIC-ordering, and source-cap blockers while preserving its existing oversized-image proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The model-aware compression design and much of the media-understanding runtime history route through this owner trail.
